keyPoints.en: Kedah has early roots and adopted Islam early.
keyPoints.bm: Kedah berakar awal dan menerima Islam awal.

keyPoints.en: Kelantan's current line goes back to Long Yunus.
keyPoints.bm: Keturunan semasa Kelantan bermula dengan Long Yunus.

keyPoints.en: Negeri Sembilan and Perlis have unique origins.
keyPoints.bm: Negeri Sembilan dan Perlis mempunyai asal usul unik.

meaning.en: A line of rulers from one family.

tip.en: Traditional stories and dated records are different kinds of evidence.

keyPoints.en: Ties were built through marriage, religion and trade.
keyPoints.bm: Hubungan dibina melalui perkahwinan, agama dan perdagangan.

keyPoints.en: Envoys and letters kept diplomacy alive.
Northern states had relations with Siam too.
keyPoints.bm: Negeri utara turut berhubung dengan Siam.
